pair.title: Nibe S configuration
pair.not_connected: Not connected to the heat pump

detect.title: Detecting features
detect.intro: Connecting to the heat pump and watching which values change. This takes about half a minute.
detect.failed: Could not read from the heat pump

features.title: Select features
features.intro: Choose which features to monitor. Recommendations are based on what the heat pump reported.
features.insights_note: Disabling a feature removes its capabilities, including their Insights history.

sources.prompt: More than one sensor can report this. Pick the one that should regulate:

devices.title: Add devices
devices.intro: Each function of your pump becomes its own device. The ones we found live data for are checked, but you can add any of them.
devices.select_one: Select at least one device to add.
devices.main_desc: Overview: outdoor temperature, operating priority and mode, plus diagnostics and statistics
devices.analytics_desc: Helps the app author see which pump models and features are actually used, and where setup fails. No personal data, no readings from your home, no network details. You can change this later under app settings.

discover.title: Find your heat pump
discover.searching: Searching your network for Nibe heat pumps…
discover.confirm: Found your heat pump — tap to confirm
discover.none_found: No heat pump found automatically. Check that Modbus TCP is enabled on the pump (menu 7.5.9) or enter its IP address below.

tank.title: Hot water tank
tank.hint: Needed for the hot water estimate. One entry per family — the lining doesn't matter.

gateway.title: Gateway connection
gateway.hint: Connect MODBUS 40 through an RTU-to-TCP bridge, or use a compatible nibegw-esp gateway. F-series support is experimental and read-only.
gateway.invalid: Choose a gateway, a port from 1–65535 and a Modbus ID from 1–247.
gateway.detect_intro: Checking the values your heat pump reports. Depending on the gateway, this can take several minutes.
